chunks: And everything in this book that is narrated from Dawud Al-Sarmi has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn Al-Mutawakkil - may Allah be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah and Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim together, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa ibn 'Ubayd, from Dawud Al-Sarmi.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together, indicating that Sa'd and Ali transmitted from the same source simultaneously or jointly.
key_terms.دَاوُدَ الصَّرْمِيِّ: Dawud Al-Sarmi, a prominent narrator whose chain is being clarified.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him, an honorific used for the narrator Muhammad ibn Musa.

ai.seo_question: How is the transmission chain for Dawud Al-Sarmi narrations verified in Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq explicitly distinguishes his personal transmission (tadris) of Dawud al-Sarmi's narrations from other chains, highlighting the rigorous methodological standards of the Kufan school in verifying the reliability of individual narrators. This specific isnad, linking back to prominent figures like Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, underscores the scholarly emphasis on traceable, direct chains to ensure the authenticity of hadith in the absence of the Imam.
